purpose: Replace fragile endpoint narratives with implementation-level causal/accounting laws that can be proved algebraically and stress-tested across fresh synthetic states and parameter settings.

laws.name: local underground exponential survival
laws.statement: For one direct underground-disruption event in locality l, before any other process acts, rooted armed membership obeys M_l^+ = M_l^- * exp(-h_l * dt), where h_l = lambda_U * I_l * (0.35 + 0.65 S_l) * (0.45 + 0.55 A_l), subject only to the implementation clamp/roundoff boundary.
required_checks: returned disrupted mass equals M_l^- - M_l^+
organization member_population falls by the same disrupted represented mass

laws.name: underground-fielded-force separation
laws.statement: The direct underground-disruption event does not alter already-fielded formation personnel; it only reduces rooted membership and removes up to fighter_conversion_fraction times disrupted represented mass from the unfielded manpower pool.
required_checks: fielded formation personnel are bitwise unchanged by the direct event
organization capital is unchanged by the direct event
unfielded manpower removal never exceeds the fighter-equivalent of disrupted membership

laws.name: recruitment hazard factorization
laws.statement: For a live target organization at a frozen interval boundary, total instantaneous recruitment hazard satisfies H = r * E * Ibar exactly up to floating-point summation tolerance, where E is eligible represented mass and Ibar is the eligible-mass-weighted mean combined recruitment intensity.

laws.name: fighter equipment capital conversion
laws.statement: For a positive local fighter increment d, let s = formation_supply_days * initial_supply_fraction, P be the pre-event unfielded fighter pool, Q the pre-event supply reserve, and K available organization capital. The immediate capital conversion is C = min(K, max((P+d)*s - Q, 0)).
required_checks: capital_before - capital_after equals C across pool/reserve/capital cases
fully funded balanced-reserve special case reduces to C = d*s
represented-recruit special case reduces to C = recruited_mass * fighter_conversion_fraction * s when reserve is balanced and capital is nonbinding

promotion_rule: A structural law is promoted only if its algebraic derivation matches the implementation and every preregistered stress case passes within explicit numerical tolerance. One failure blocks promotion and is entered in the falsification ledger.
claim_boundary: These are theorems of the implemented Pineland model, not empirical laws of real insurgency.
